listing.summary: Provides Spanish, Turkish, and French translations for the Starsector 0.98a-RC8 base game and various mods.

description:
Starsector 0.98a-RC8 - Translation Project

Hello everyone.

I am pleased to present my translation project for Starsector 0.98a-RC8. This work includes the translation of the base game and several popular mods.

There are parts that are not translated, but most of the text is translated and you will be able to play and understand the stories and events.

Installation Instructions

Core Game Translation

File: FlickerLeaf.Spanish.Starsector.0.98a-RC8.zip

Go to the game root folder: E:\Starsector 0.98a-RC8Extract the ZIP file here (right-click - Extract Here)Launch Starsector - it is now translated

Mod Translations (Example: Adversary)

File: FlickerLeaf.Spanish.Starsector.0.98a-RC8_Adversary v7.12.zip

Go to the mod folder: E:\Starsector 0.98a-RC8\mods\Adversary-v7.1.2Extract the ZIP file here (right-click - Extract Here)Launch Starsector - the mod is now translated

Supported Languages

Language

Core Game File

Mods File

SpanishFlickerLeaf.Spanish.Starsector 0.98a-RC8 v1.01.zip FlickerLeaf.Spanish.Starsector 0.98a-RC8 Mods v1.01.zipTurkishFlickerLeaf.Turkish.Starsector 0.98a-RC8 v1.00.zip FlickerLeaf.Turkish.Starsector 0.98a-RC8 All Mods v1.00.zipFrenchFlickerLeaf.French.Starsector 0.98a-RC8.zipFlickerLeaf.French.Starsector 0.98a-RC8 All Mods.zip

Quote

Note about Turkish: Translation files contain correct characters, but the Starsector engine cannot render certain Turkish characters properly in-game. This is a game engine limitation, not a translation error.

Quote

Translation Process: Each complete translation (core game plus mods) requires approximately 30 hours of work to ensure quality and accuracy.
